orchestrator_output.reformulated_query: Who is considered the fastest racer in the world?
orchestrator_output.text_narration: When we talk about the 'fastest racer' in the world, it often refers to the fastest human in track and field. The legendary sprinter Usain Bolt from Jamaica is widely considered the fastest man ever. He holds the world records for the 100-meter dash (9.58 seconds) and the 200-meter dash (19.19 seconds), which he set in 2009. Even though he has retired from professional athletics, his records remain unbroken as of today, July 28, 2026, making him the fastest human in recorded history for these distances.
